name: Riken Vitamin Co., Ltd.
summary: Riken Vitamin Co., Ltd. engages in the food ingredient, food and chemical improving agents, health care, consumer and commercial products, and vitamins businesses in Japan. It offers dressing, such as non-oil dressings; seaweed; and extract, seasoning, soup, soup stock, retort-packed food, salad-related products, seafood, meat extracts, and cut wakame.
